summary: Phase 10 (cs5_completeness) unchanged, landed. Phase 11.3 (nik_TS5_consistent, the anti-vacuity certificate) LANDED this dispatch, sorry-free and axiom-clean, via the plan's own pre-authorized direct route: a new lemma nik_soundness_onePoint (full 12-constructor NIK soundness induction against a one-point model, World := Unit, r := fun _ _ => True) proves nik_TS5_consistent directly, without routing through the not-yet-landed general nik_TS5_soundness. Phase 11.1/11.2 (the general theorem) remain NOT landed: this dispatch attempted an actual Lean encoding of the (boxI) case and found the prior handoff's tree-path-propagation framing does not close -- TS5={T,B,Four} makes TClosure TS5 an equivalence relation, and G is always connected (a tree, undirected), so TClosure TS5 G.R is the TOTAL relation on G.X: edge-cond requires r to hold between EVERY pair of labels used so far (an r-clique condition), not just tree-adjacent pairs. cs5FCIncest_lift's raised witness is existential-not-exact, so satisfying one new label's clique membership against an existing label cascades to raising that label too. The corrected target is a finite-set clique-lifting lemma (not a tree-depth recursion), not yet attempted in Lean. This refined analysis is recorded in Soundness.lean's docstring and a new continuation handoff. NOT a blocker -- scope/budget continuation, matching the plan's own multi-dispatch estimate. Phase 12 correctly not started (depends on 11 completing).
decisions_made: Landed nik_TS5_consistent directly against a one-point model (nik_soundness_onePoint) rather than waiting for the general nik_TS5_soundness, exactly as the plan's Rollback/Contingency section and the prior dispatch's handoff pre-authorized. Verified this needs no cs5FCIncest witness at all (the statement nik_TS5_consistent never mentions CKValidFC/cs5FCIncest), only a plain CKForces model with botForces := fun _ => False and Gamma = [] (vacuous context condition).

Attempted an actual Lean encoding of the (boxI) case of the general induction (not just re-stating architecture) and found the prior dispatch's tree-path-propagation framing for the graph-lifting lemma does not close, for a reason not previously identified: TS5's T+B+Four makes TClosure TS5 an equivalence relation, and G is always connected, so TClosure TS5 G.R is total on G.X -- edge-cond is an r-clique condition on ALL labels used so far, not a tree-adjacency condition. Traced why cs5FCIncest_lift alone is insufficient (its raised witness is existential, not exact, so satisfying one label's clique membership cascades to raising others). Did NOT force through a broken/sorry'd attempt at the general theorem given this depth of difficulty; recorded the refined target (a finite-set clique-lifting lemma) for the next dispatch instead.

Reverted 3 unrelated import lines (SchemaSoundness, SchemaBridges, SchemaUnion) that lake exe mk_all --module picked up from a concurrent task's (523) untracked files, to keep this dispatch's Cslib.lean diff empty/scoped to task 517.
Phase 12 correctly NOT started, per the plan's own sequencing note (depends on 10, 11 both completing so its bookkeeping reflects the FINAL state).
dead_ends: Tree-path propagation for the graph-lifting lemma (raise x, cascade to x's descendants only, keep ancestors/other labels fixed): does not close, because TClosure TS5 G.R is the TOTAL relation on G.X (T+B+Four = equivalence closure of a connected graph), not just tree-adjacency -- edge-cond needs an r-clique across ALL labels, not a tree-edge relation. Do not resume this exact framing; see the new handoff's 'corrected target' section for the finite-set clique-lifting lemma that should replace it.

Raising only the newly-introduced fresh label y (keeping all pre-existing labels, including x itself, fixed) while trying to satisfy x -> y's edge-cond from hru : r w' u (w' >= rho x): fails because cs5FCIncest has no 'downward' fact letting an edge at a raised point w' imply an edge at the original rho x -- confirmed by direct case analysis against all 5 cs5FCIncest conjuncts (hrefl, htrans, hfour, hsymbox, hincest), none of which provide this.

Raising x's own value directly (rho' x := w', keeping ancestors fixed): breaks edge-cond for x's own incoming parent edge (or, per the corrected clique framing, ALL of x's TClosure-clique neighbours), and cs5FCIncest_lift only raises SOURCES of an existing edge to produce a raised TARGET, not the reverse (raising a TARGET while keeping its source fixed) -- confirmed this is not the right decomposition either.

continuation_context.next_phase_note: Phase 11.1/11.2 continuation (the general nik_TS5_soundness): build the corrected finite-set clique-lifting lemma (NOT the tree-path-propagation framing from the prior handoff, which this dispatch found does not close) -- given a finite set S of labels already r-clique-related under rho, and one member x raised to w' >= rho x, produce rho' >= rho pointwise on S (every member's value may need to rise) such that S is again an r-clique under rho', using hfour/hsymbox/hincest pairwise via finite induction over S. Then the main 12-constructor NIK soundness induction (item 3), folding TClosure validation (former item 4 / Phase 11.2) directly into edge-cond rather than as a separate pass, since TClosure TS5 G.R is now understood to be the total relation on G.X. Full refined analysis in Soundness.lean's 'Refined analysis of items 1-4' docstring section and specs/517_labelled_bounded_context_cs5_completeness/handoffs/phase-11-general-soundness-handoff-20260719b.md. Phase 11.3 (nik_TS5_consistent) is DONE -- do not re-attempt. Phase 12 (bookkeeping) remains blocked on Phase 11 per the plan's own sequencing -- do not attempt it early.
